I created this subverse for those who wish to contribute to Minity Dark. Here, contributing means:

  • Reporting issues with the theme.

  • Discussing the theme and anything related.

  • Getting involved in the code that powers Minity Dark.

Minity Dark still needs a lot of work and testing, so I'll need your help in forming it to be a great alternative to the light version. Your feedback and contributions are appreciated!
Get ready to be an essential part in Minity Dark's development!

I made a few tweaks to the design. Here are the changes:

  • Add hyperlink color.

  • Link titles are bolded specifically, rather than the whole line.

  • Link titles are lighter to compensate the bolding.

  • Tag line hyperlinks are underlined on-hover.

  • Decrease tag line margins.

  • Change visited links to violet.

  • Button shadows are more subtle.

  • Evening of the padding in link markdown.

  • Sidebar titlebox borders are lighter.

  • Link markdown box is lighter.

  • Moderator list is a shaded box.

  • Change line breaks to paragraph tags for the About page.

I also created a subverse for the alternate Minity version, Minity Dark. We'd love it if you'd come over and contribute by reporting issues, discussing the theme, and even getting involved in the code!.

The theme still needs to be updated from the recent WhoaVerse changes, so it may look a little weird for a short while.

Thank you for your support!
